Parking Enforcement.description: This type is for reporting parking violations or issues related to abandoned vehicles. Residents can request enforcement action to ensure compliance with parking regulations.
resident_phrases: There's a car parked in front of my driveway again!
Can someone check on that abandoned vehicle on my street?
I see a lot of cars parked illegally around here, can you do something?

Improper Storage of Trash (Barrels).description: This type addresses issues with trash barrels being stored improperly, which can lead to neighborhood cleanliness problems. Residents can report barrels left out on the street or inappropriately placed.
resident_phrases: My neighbor keeps leaving their trash barrels out all week, it's a mess!

There's a shopping cart just sitting on the sidewalk, can you pick it up?

Requests for Street Cleaning.description: This type is for residents to request street cleaning services in their area. It helps keep the streets clean and free of debris.

CE Collection.description: This type is for reporting collections related to street cleaning efforts. It is used internally by city staff to manage collection requests.

Schedule a Bulk Item Pickup.description: This type allows residents to schedule pickups for large items that need to be disposed of. It's a convenient way to get rid of bulky waste.

Needle Pickup.description: This type is for reporting the need for needle pickups in public areas. It helps ensure safety and cleanliness in the community.

Tree Maintenance Requests.description: This type is for residents to request maintenance for trees in public spaces. It helps ensure the health and safety of urban trees.

Request for Pothole Repair.description: This request type is for reporting potholes or sinkholes on city streets that need repair. Residents can help improve road safety by notifying the city about these issues.
